svg.font-family: Inter, Segoe UI, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
svg.text: LoanFlow — Multi-Agent Loan Processing on Cloud Run (LangGraph supervisor · ReAct subagents · MCP tools)
Input: applicant_id + document_id → Output: auditable FinalDecision (APPROVED / REJECTED) with reasons, report hash and audit trail
Supervisor Worker (Cloud Run, always-on CPU, N replicas) — LangGraph StateGraph · the "brain"
Memory layer — used by the supervisor and every subagent
Free LLMs — supervisor CoT + agent ReAct
KV cache: stable static prefix first
LangFuse: trace per run, spans per
node / tool, generations per LLM call
7 Subagents — each its own Cloud Run service (internal ingress, IAM-invoked) · ReAct loop: Thought → Action(MCP tool) → Observation → … → Finish
5 MCP Servers (Streamable HTTP, internal) — the bank's systems behind typed tools
